newsitem.title: USA: Brown Brothers admits Robert Gould to partnership.
newsitem.headline: Brown Brothers admits Robert Gould to partnership.

text.p: Brown Brothers Harriman & Co on Monday said it admitted Robert R. Gould as a partner of the firm.

Gould, 36, joined the New York office of the country's oldest and largest private bank in 1981 after receiving his bachelor of sciences degree from Yale University. He received his Master of Business Administration degree from New York University in 1987.

After seven years in the commercial banking side of the firm, Gould joined the corporate finance and mergers and acquisitions department in 1988. Becoming a senior manager in 1994, he has special responsibilities in advising substantial private companies.
He is also active in selecting and managing private equity investments on behalf of the firm's family of 1818 Funds.
